topics.title: Projects v3: unify sharing, discussions, and issue ownership

entries.title: Projects v3: unify sharing, discussions, and issue ownership
entries.rationale: Accepted as a broad Projects capability, but only through a dedicated security and compatibility adaptation. It adds owner/managed-agent signing, issue assignment trust rules, project announcements, repository workflows, deep links, relay search, and a stated webbrowser RUSTSEC remediation that is not present as a lockfile delta in this commit.
entries.dependency_resolution: Re-verify the claimed webbrowser remediation against the actual lockfiles before implementation; the commit tree retains webbrowser 1.2.4 in both lockfiles and changes no dependency lock entry.
security_reasons: owner and managed-agent private-key selection for project announcements and issue operations
assignment/unassignment authorization and causal operation reduction across relay history
project repository creation, clone, push, and merge workflows with local filesystem and git boundaries
relay search of channel discussions and result-cap privacy behavior
commit message claims RUSTSEC-2026-0257 remediation without a corresponding dependency diff

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated Projects threat review, owner/agent authorization tests, git/filesystem boundary tests, dependency advisory verification, migration/compatibility checks, visible-Zion and platform-brand checks, and desktop/Tauri/CLI gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, owner identity/signing paths, assignment reducers, repository workflow paths, relay search limits, changed tests, lockfile/dependency claim, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
